definitions: To direct a mass of tiny drops of liquid or fine particles of powder at something.
To apply a liquid or powder to (something) in a mass of tiny drops or fine particles.
To scatter or cause to be scattered over an area in a mass or stream.
To produce a fine stream of liquid or gas.
examples: He sprayed water on the plants.
The car was sprayed with paint.
Mud sprayed up from the wheels.
